# Dashboard output directory (generated by scripts/build_dashboard.py)

**Publication status (2026-08-14):** no current dashboard is publication-ready. A valid dashboard must distinguish replication from matched comparisons and show integrity status, quality warnings, seed coverage, confidence source, finish/cap/loop rates, latency distribution, peak VRAM, energy availability, and cost assumptions. See [the publication audit](../docs/PUBLICATION_READINESS.md) and [recovery plan](../docs/plans/2026-08-14-publication-recovery.md).

```bash
python scripts/build_dashboard.py \
  --archive outputs-hpc-2a100-main-YYYY-MM-DD-rerun \
  --output dashboards/index.html
```

Open `index.html` only after a recovery-plan archive passes its publication gate. Historical dashboards remain diagnostic.
